items.author: Dimitris Angelides, Oct 29
items.summary: He built an HR attrition dashboard suite in Tableau, then had Claude build the same suite from a prompt, and compares them side by side. Claude was fast, but several numbers were wrong until he checked them, and a basic prompt produced basic dashboards.

items.author: Jonas Thordal (Weld), Oct 28
items.summary: Claude now builds a live dashboard from one prompt, with SQL you can inspect. He argues the real problem is too many dashboards and too little trust in metrics, so core numbers still need shared definitions.

items.author: Kyle Chalmers with Will Sutton (2022 Iron Viz champion), Oct 26
items.summary: A video on setting up Claude with Tableau, covering Will's Tableau Public MCP connector, which lets Claude inspect how any public dashboard is built, and the upcoming Tableau Studio.

items.author: Enrico Bertini, Oct 28
items.summary: Channel Brewer, a small interactive tool for exploring pairs of visual channels, built for teaching data viz. It's the first of a planned library of small apps.

items.author: Navneet Loiwal (Coefficient), Oct 28
items.summary: A vendor launch of SuperAgent, a data agent that scans Salesforce to learn how your systems work.
